kind.description: Kind discriminator. Always 'hook' for this schema.

name.description: Slug identifying this hook bundle. Lowercase, hyphenated.

host.description: Target host that executes this hook. 'artifacts-os' for local execution; 'openstation' and other values are reserved foreign hosts.

matcher.description: Key/value pairs that must match the event for the hook to fire. Supports: event, kind, id, name, stem, path, changed, result, before, after, fields.<k>, before.<k>, after.<k>.

action.description: Action to execute when the hook fires. Must include 'type' (shell|notify|file-drop) plus type-specific fields.

command.description: Shell command to run (shell action only). Relative paths resolve against the bundle directory.

phase.description: Lifecycle phase to fire in. 'post' (default) runs after the operation; 'pre' runs before.

blocking.description: When true and phase is 'pre', a failing hook aborts the operation with BlockedByPreHook.

timeout.description: Maximum seconds the action may run before being killed.
